TARGET TOOL: CodeBuddy / MODE: Balanced
You are CodeBuddy. Branch cb/wardrobe-locks from origin/main. Phone app in mobile/.

Goal: World & wardrobe rewards unlock when Buddy's lifetime hearts reach a number (never spent, never go down), plus a demo switch in Settings that unlocks everything.

1. Hearts total: read today?.dog.heartsTotal if the API sends it (P1 is adding it; don't edit shared/), else a mock value in mobile/src/mock (30). Keep this lookup in one place in App.tsx.
2. Milestones: under "{{count}} caring days together" add one line "{{count}} hearts together" (en.json, plural forms).
3. One helper, mobile/src/lib/rewards.ts: isUnlocked(itemId, heartsTotal, demoUnlockAll). Thresholds only in mobile/src/config/rewards.ts: hat 20 hearts, glasses 40, kampung 60; flat, garden, "none" and flower always unlocked (flower is a gift from the caretaker).
4. CustomizeScreen: locked items are dimmed with a small lock and the note "{{count}} hearts". Tapping one doesn't equip it; it shows a gentle toast "{{name}} unlocks this at {{count}} hearts." The "All unlocked" scenery subtitle comes from the data.
5. Settings: a new card directly under the "Caretaker check-ins" card, eyebrow "Demo", one checkbox "Unlock all rewards (demo)". State lives in App.tsx (not saved).
6. All new text in en.json with {{name}}/{{count}}. In mock/milestones.ts: note back to "accessory.justPet" (it was hardcoded "Just Buddy"), and "From Jamie" uses the caretaker's name from data.
Don't edit index.css's accessory section or the landscape media query (another branch is changing them); add new styles at the end of the wardrobe section. Don't edit shared/, api/ or mobile/src/lib/api.ts.
Run in mobile/: npx tsc --noEmit and npm run build; in root: npm run test:unit. Open a PR.
</user_query>"}]}
